name: Sweet Sweet Cafe
source:
Welcome to Ribbon Cream Soda's Cafe! Where desserts and beverages of all kinds are served to equally sweet customers... But today, someone strange has appeared.

Today, you'll accompany Ribbon Cream Soda as she takes orders and chats with customers – but when an unknown dessert arrives, everything takes a turn for the worse.

[From [url=https://himedesignworks.itch.io/sweet-sweet-cafe]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到Ribbon Cream Soda咖啡馆！那里为同样甜蜜的顾客提供各种甜点和饮料……但是今天，出现了一个奇怪的人。

今天，你将陪伴Ribbon Cream Soda接受订单并与顾客聊天 - 但当一种未知的甜点到来时，一切都变得更糟。

[来自[url=https://himedesignworks.itch.io/sweet-sweet-cafe]Itch.io[/url]]
